Canonical hash of a configuration

Source: R/config.R
gk_config_hash.Rd

SHA-256 of the canonical JSON form of a configuration: object keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace, numbers in shortest round-trip form. The hash is therefore identical for configurations that differ only in key order, whitespace or numeric spelling in their JSON files, and changes whenever a rule, threshold setting, flag policy, override or refinement changes.

gk_config_hash(config)

Arguments

config

A gk_config().

Value

A 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string.

See also

Other configuration: gk_config(), gk_hierarchy(), gk_min_support(), gk_panel(), gk_signal_policy(), gk_validate_config(), gk_write_config(), hierarchy-elements

Examples

gk_config_hash(gk_example_config())
#> [1] "2bdc84a359852919307483c7b938813135e5ed1d77cbf339ab19b33480f5c232"
